text.en:
Registration of Births and Deaths Act
(Chapter 267)
Appointment of Deputy Registrar
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 3(2) of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, the Minister for Home Affairs has appointed the Commanding Officer, Sengkang Neighbourhood Police Centre, to be a Deputy Registrar of Births and Deaths for the purposes of the Act, with effect from 5th October 2004.
